entities.name: NASH
observations: Biopsy-confirmed nonalcoholic steatohepatitis evaluated for histologic resolution in the PIVENS trial analysis.

entities.name: NASH resolution lipids
observations: In 222 nondiabetic adults with paired biopsies over 96 weeks, histologic NASH resolution was associated with HDL-C increase of 2.9 mg/dL versus a 2.5 mg/dL decrease without resolution (P<0.001).
Triglycerides decreased 21.1 mg/dL with resolution versus 2.3 mg/dL without resolution (P=0.03); TG/HDL ratio changed -0.7 versus +0.1 (P=0.003).
LDL-C and non-HDL-C declined in both groups without significant resolution-specific between-group differences.

entities.name: NASH lipid meta-analysis
observations: A network meta-analysis of 43 biopsy-proven NASH randomized trials assessed treatment effects rather than whether individual histologic resolution predicted lipid changes.

Treatment classes showed heterogeneous effects, including HDL improvement, triglyceride reduction, and LDL-C reductions with some classes; therefore the analysis is indirect for resolution-specific associations.

entities.name: PMID:25429853 PIVENS lipids
observations: Post hoc paired-biopsy analysis examined lipid changes by histologic NASH resolution in the PIVENS trial.
